name: instagram-deepdive
description: Turn an Instagram URL into a deep-dive content-analysis report. Scrapes recent posts/reels via the Apify MCP, ranks by engagement, and builds an interactive zine-style HTML deep-dive of a chosen reel — frame-by-frame storyboard, scene-cut & pacing analysis, 3-second hook breakdown, viewer emotion-flow chart with synced player, why-it-went-viral metrics, target/weakness analysis, cross-domain benchmarking patterns, and a 0-100 Reel Health Score with Quick Wins.
